name: Ossein Cage
summary: The Ossein Cage is a Coldharbour prison that is accessible from Solstice. It houses the Dolorous Cista, a vessel that harvests mortal suffering and converts it to magical energy. It is also one of the many vaults that Mannimarco used to hide artifacts and objects of power. It is also the trial for the zone, and the entrance can be found in some Argonian ruins, where an Oblivion portal can be found inside. Centipedes, rats, spiders and torchbugs are found within the Saxhleel ruin. Daedrats, fiendroths, frogs, scuttlers, snakes, and torchbugs are found within Coldharbour. Hazards include bottomless pits. You will receive a Shattered Horn of the Overfiend along with your other rewards after defeating Overfiend Kazpian with Hard Mode engaged.
